headline: Failed House rule would have set the terms for debating a bill to extend FISA Title VII surveillance powers through October 20, 2027.
what_it_does: This resolution would have set the rules for how the House debates and votes on H.R. 8035. That bill would extend the government's authorities under Title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act through October 20, 2027. The resolution itself would not have changed any surveillance law. It would only have allowed the House to take up the bill under agreed procedures. The House voted it down on April 17, 2026.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House of Representatives
who_it_affects.how: They would have debated and voted on the FISA extension bill under the procedures this resolution set.
